evidence_provenance: Counts and outcomes below were transcribed from retained logs and artifacts under .cache/build/dev/evidence/pixel-composer-2026-10-02, except the focused timeline-only result, which was supplied by the root agent. No whole-tree source snapshot or tested binary hashes were captured for this record. Build47 outcomes use the retained build47 logs listed per gate. Build49 evidence was executed across the Oct 2-3 Darwin boundary; individual log timestamps are retained per gate. The build49 capability inventory was produced by a temporary helper linked against the archived build49 static library and is not a behavioral parity claim. Build50 final accepted development and release core suites, I/O, export, focused Studio, client CPU adapters, CPU-filtered renderer, and examples are recorded below. Earlier failed build50 attempts remain in excluded_or_failed_runs where superseded by later accepted runs.

Instrumented frame ranges: static 2D 0.230383-0.246263 ms, animation 3.686618-3.830759 ms, temporal 1.990220-2.007422 ms, Verlet 0.358313-0.421281 ms, CPU 3D 0.054763-0.055995 ms. CPU 3D is not GPU performance evidence; these bounded headless CPU micrograph measurements do not establish representative full-graph acceptance for all required workload classes.

limitations: These native gates cover only the named test and architecture scopes. They do not complete M0-M7 acceptance.
Source camera and SDF renderer slices now have bounded native CPU coverage; full camera/SDF, simulation, and GPU acceptance remain open.
The OKLCH numeric comparison covers helper translation only and does not establish product parity.
External licensed Pixel Composer parity, fractional key-map comparison, and live GUI verification remain unverified.
Seven scene files exist, but manual and GPU acceptance remains pending.
Noise Aniso and captured MK Sparkle native kernels are present; full supplied-project acceptance and matched reference behavior remain open. Grid and Path Shape native work remains incomplete.
No accepted full GPU gate is recorded; the focused filtered run included unintended camera GPU cases and failed.
No full source tree or tested binary hash snapshot ties these outputs to every current source edit.
